description: Triggers a Puppet agent run restricted to a comma-separated list of tags, with optional extra agent flags. Runs on Linux, macOS and Windows.

tags.description: Comma separated list of tags with no spaces, eg 'profile::ntp,profile::ssh'. Mandatory.

flags.description: Optional, space-separated additional puppet agent flags, eg '--noop --debug'. Replaces the legacy param1/param2 parameters.
